zh.title: 日本出動戰機應對中國軍機飛近沖繩
zh.summary: 日本10月19日出動戰機，應對飛近沖繩的兩架中國軍用無人機及一架Y-9
body: AeroTime報導，日本於2026年10月19日出動戰機；當天兩架中國軍用無人機及一架Y-9情報蒐集機飛近沖繩，時間正值「Keen Sword 27」演習開幕日。日本航空自衛隊從西南航空方面隊出動戰機，並拍攝了三架飛機。
報導指出，BZK-005偵察無人機與Y-9從東海飛入，經沖繩本島與宮古島之間進入太平洋。TB-001偵察及攻擊無人機則從臺灣與日本與那國島之間進入太平洋，飛至奄美大島外海後折返，再從沖繩與宮古島之間離開。

en.title: Japan Scrambles Fighters as Chinese Aircraft Fly Near Okinawa
en.summary: Japan scrambled fighters after two Chinese military drones and a Y-9 flew near Okinawa on October 19, 2026.
body: AeroTime reported that Japan scrambled fighter jets on October 19, 2026, after two Chinese military drones and a Y-9 intelligence-gathering aircraft flew near Okinawa on the opening day of Keen Sword 27. The Japan Air Self-Defense Force said it scrambled fighters from its Southwestern Air Defense Force and photographed all three aircraft.

A BZK-005 reconnaissance drone and the Y-9 flew in from the East China Sea and passed between Okinawa’s main island and Miyakojima into the Pacific Ocean. A TB-001 reconnaissance and attack drone entered the Pacific between Taiwan and Japan’s Yonaguni Island, flew as far as waters off Amami Oshima, then turned back and exited between Okinawa and Miyakojima.
